method: Native Windows 98 controls and GDI screenshots
restoration: Helper snapshots live settings before changes and attempts restoration on completion or detected error. Guest backup: C:\THEMECAP\SHOW6T.BIN (test) or SHOW6F.BIN (full).

verification.backgroundCheck: Bottom-right pixel compared to JSON Background RGB, allowing 8 levels per channel for display quantization.
verification.visualReview: All controls and desktop views reviewed as contact sheets; representative menu, tooltip, and message views reviewed individually.

notes: Native screenshot elements cropped and rearranged; controls are not redrawn.
The inactive window is partially occluded by the active sample window.
Multiple active-looking UI states are shown together for comparison.
Desktop icon-label text contrast is chosen by the helper.
Original screenshots retained outside the repository.
